nodes.name: entry-ecs
nodes.note: Shanghai entry ECS: panel-tier nginx (EdgeOne origin), relay last resort, and the master container's host. Its relay upstream list is written by ecs-fleet-sync from the local ESS view; the release flips its nginx on commit and gates on its upstream file.

nodes.name: eci-ml
nodes.note: Alibaba Cloud ECI is recreated by ESS; instance ID, private IP, public IP and image digest are runtime state, never hand-maintained here.

nodes.name: rds-ml
nodes.note: RDS PostgreSQL private endpoint; access is restricted to the ECI fleet's VPC (the SWAS private network left the path on 2026-10-05).

nodes.name: edgeone-cn
nodes.note: Tencent EdgeOne public entry; origin is the Shanghai entry ECS (47.101.40.104), not the retired Chengdu lightweight tier.
